business_problem: Ocean Imagerie faced a 25% increase in imaging volumes across more than 24 locations while operating fragmented, site-specific systems with limited workflow visibility and no centralized access, which slowed collaboration, duplicated effort, and made internal teleradiology and multisite coverage difficult to scale.
solution_summary: Ocean Imagerie partnered with Philips to centralize its radiology operations around Philips PACS as a single imaging workspace for a multisite network in southwestern France. Imaging studies from clinics, offices, scanners, and MRI locations are made accessible through the centralized PACS so radiologists can read exams from home or on-site through one interface instead of switching between disconnected local systems. Philips PACS serves as the common access point for image review, prior-exam comparison, multisite coordination, and internal teleradiology. AI-enabled capabilities, delivered through Philips Advanced Visualization Workspace and integrated third-party applications, provide advanced post-processing and AI-assisted features inside the workflow, helping radiologists interpret CT, MRI, and X-ray studies faster. Philips also supported data migration, training, workflow customization for multisite operations, and a single-entry-point security model.
